route.why: Easy arrival, a kid-paced heritage walk plus a half-day at Cherai Beach as a gentler second day.
Interactive stops — Tea Museum, Mattupetty boating — alongside the scenery; more to do, not just see.
The wildlife anchor of this trip: a boat safari and an ethically vetted elephant interaction, unrushed.
A backwater day cruise, not an overnight — easier with young children, same highlight.
Calm, shallow water by Kerala coastal standards, plus the trip's unstructured day.

days.label: Fort Kochi, kid-paced
days.body: A shorter heritage walk — fishing nets, Mattancherry Palace — with breaks built in, plus a backwater village canoe ride that plays more than it tours.

days.label: Cherai Beach, then Munnar
days.body: A calm morning at shallow, quiet Cherai before a ~4-hour drive up, kept to a half-day so the climb still starts by early afternoon.

days.label: Munnar
days.body: The Tea Museum's working demonstrations in the morning, Mattupetty Dam's pedal- and speedboats in the afternoon, plus a gentle estate walk.

days.label: Periyar boat safari
days.body: A morning boat safari — no walking required, good odds for all ages — then an ethically vetted elephant feeding and bathing session, no riding.

days.label: Thekkady, second day
days.body: A short, flat spice-plantation walk ending in a tasting, then an evening Kalaripayattu demonstration that reliably lands with kids and teens.

days.label: Kumarakom day cruise
days.body: Arrive by lunch; an afternoon backwater day cruise plus a coir-workshop village walk, hands-on and short.

days.label: Drive to Marari Beach
days.body: The shortest transfer in the trip, about an hour to 90 minutes. Rest of the day free.

days.label: Marari, unstructured
days.body: Beach and village cycling — nothing booked.

stays.name: Taj Malabar (or similar)
stays.why: A larger-format property with family rooms and a pool — more practical than a small boutique stay.

stays.name: CGH Earth or comparable estate
stays.why: Family-configured cottages — interconnecting or two-bedroom units.

stays.name: Spice Village (CGH Earth)
stays.why: A cottage layout that suits families, a short walk from the elephant-interaction centre.

stays.name: Coconut Lagoon (CGH Earth) or Kumarakom Lake Resort
stays.why: A lakeside resort with a pool and family rooms, well used given the day-cruise structure.

stays.name: Marari Beach Resort (CGH Earth)
stays.why: Cottage-style, safe swimming by Kerala coastal standards, with bicycles for the village.
